records.text: A Radford University report coauthored by Jerri Frantzve included her mother Marjorie Weiland among the listed authors without disclosing the family relationship
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Jerri Frantzve. Well, not what she doesn't communicate in this report is that that's her family. Marjorie Wayland is her mom.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. The report's catalog record supports that Jerri Frantzve and Marjorie Weiland were coauthors, but no reliable source located establishes that Weiland was Jerri's mother or that disclosure was legally or academically required.
